function GUI.updateRoom() GUI.debug("GUI/ROOM", "updating room display", { room = msdp and msdp.ROOM, roomName = msdp and msdp.ROOM_NAME, roomVnum = msdp and msdp.ROOM_VNUM, areaName = msdp and msdp.AREA_NAME, roomExits = msdp and msdp.ROOM_EXITS, }) local roomInfo = [[
]] if msdp.ROOM.ENVIRONMENT == "Wilderness" then -- Wilderness display roomInfo = roomInfo .. [[

]] roomInfo = roomInfo .. [[

🌲 WILDERNESS 🌲

]] roomInfo = roomInfo .. [[
]] -- Coordinates roomInfo = roomInfo .. [[

]] roomInfo = roomInfo .. [[Coords: (]] roomInfo = roomInfo .. (msdp.ROOM.COORDS.X or "?") .. ", " .. (msdp.ROOM.COORDS.Y or "?") roomInfo = roomInfo .. [[)

]] -- Terrain roomInfo = roomInfo .. [[

]] roomInfo = roomInfo .. [[Terrain: ]] roomInfo = roomInfo .. (msdp.ROOM.TERRAIN or "Unknown") .. [[

]] else -- Regular room display -- Room name roomInfo = roomInfo .. [[

]] roomInfo = roomInfo .. (msdp.ROOM.NAME or "Unknown") .. [[

]] roomInfo = roomInfo .. [[
]] -- Room VNUM roomInfo = roomInfo .. [[

]] roomInfo = roomInfo .. [[Room #: ]] roomInfo = roomInfo .. (msdp.ROOM.VNUM or "Unknown") .. [[

]] -- Terrain roomInfo = roomInfo .. [[

]] roomInfo = roomInfo .. [[Terrain: ]] roomInfo = roomInfo .. (msdp.ROOM.TERRAIN or "Unknown") .. [[

]] -- Area roomInfo = roomInfo .. [[

]] roomInfo = roomInfo .. [[Area: ]] roomInfo = roomInfo .. (msdp.ROOM.AREA or "Unknown") .. [[

]] end roomInfo = roomInfo .. [[
]] GUI.buttonWindow.roomInfo:echo(roomInfo) end --Whattt to be replaced with MSDP or GMCP once coded in function GUI.updateLegend() GUI.debug("GUI/ROOM", "updating legend display")
